about.title: Engineering polymer packaging for modern industry
paragraphs: Pacnix India is a leading manufacturer of packaging tubes, poly tubes, and industrial polymer products serving FMCG, pharmaceutical, cosmetic, and industrial sectors across India and export markets.

Our integrated facility combines extrusion, printing readiness, and quality assurance under one roof — enabling faster turnaround, consistent wall thickness, and packaging that protects your product and elevates your brand.
From standard HDPE and LDPE formats to custom co-extruded solutions, we partner with procurement and R&D teams to translate specifications into reliable, scalable supply.
about.mission: To deliver precision polymer packaging that helps our customers launch faster, reduce waste, and build trust with end consumers.
about.vision: To be the most responsive packaging partner for industrial and consumer brands in India — known for quality, sustainability-minded materials, and technical collaboration.

blogs.title: Lightweighting HDPE Packaging Tubes Without Compromising Strength
blogs.excerpt: How material distribution and shoulder design influence drop performance in transit.
blogs.body:
Brand teams face dual pressure: reduce polymer usage for sustainability reporting while maintaining stack strength and consumer feel. At Pacnix India, lightweighting projects begin with a finite-element informed review of wall thickness maps—not a uniform percentage reduction.

We model filling pressures, cap engagement torque, and typical e-commerce drop orientations. Pilot runs validate ovality recovery after compression and seal integrity after temperature cycling.

Early collaboration with marketing and procurement prevents late-stage artwork changes. Documented trial batches give leadership confidence to scale.
blogs.author: Pacnix India Technical Team

blogs.title: Recycled Content in Flexible Tubes: A Practical Roadmap
blogs.excerpt: Balancing aesthetics, barrier needs, and supplier documentation for PCR blends.
blogs.body:
Post-consumer resin (PCR) programs require clarity on appearance limits, odor thresholds, and regulatory statements for target markets. We recommend a tiered approach: start with non-food adjacent SKUs, establish color acceptance panels, then expand.

Each lot retains material certificates and blend ratios for customer audits. Decoration methods may need adjustment—our prepress team shares ink adhesion guidance early.
blogs.author: Pacnix India Sustainability Cell

blogs.title: Automating Inline Tube Inspection on High-Speed Lines
blogs.excerpt: Vision and laser gauging reduce scrap while improving dimensional Cpk.
blogs.body:
Manual sampling alone cannot catch short bursts of wall variation at elevated line speeds. Inline gauging integrates with line drives to divert suspect sections before collation.

Implementation includes calibration routines, operator training, and alignment with existing AQL release rules—automation augments, not replaces, final batch review.
blogs.author: Pacnix India Operations

blogs.title: Topical Pharma Tubes: Compliance Basics for Procurement
blogs.excerpt: Questions to ask your tube supplier before artwork lock.
blogs.body:
Regulatory expectations vary by market, but common themes include material suitability, change control, and retain samples. Procurement should request validation history for similar product classes and cap seal methodologies.

Pacnix India supports structured onboarding: material declarations, trial protocols, and batch record templates aligned to your quality agreement.

faqs.question: What materials does Pacnix India manufacture with?
faqs.answer: We primarily work with HDPE, LDPE, and specialty polymer grades selected for flexibility, chemical resistance, and regulatory requirements. Material selection is confirmed during technical review.

faqs.question: Do you offer custom tube diameters and lengths?
faqs.answer: Yes. Custom tooling and dimension programs are available subject to MOQ and lead time. Share your artwork, cap specification, and filling parameters to begin feasibility.

faqs.question: What is your typical lead time?
faqs.answer: Standard SKUs often ship within agreed windows after order confirmation. Custom programs require tooling and trial timelines — our team provides a project schedule at quotation stage.

faqs.question: Can you support export documentation?
faqs.answer: We prepare batch documentation, certificates of analysis where applicable, and packing lists aligned with export requirements. Discuss destination market needs during onboarding.

faqs.question: How do I request samples?
faqs.answer: Use the contact or product enquiry form with your SKU interest and shipping details. Sample availability depends on material grade and current production schedule.
